title: feat: add Seedance 2.0 Mini and Fast
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `seedance-2.0-mini` and `seedance-2.0-fast` as distinct paid-only Replicate services with no aliases or fallback.
- Exposes Mini at 480p/720p for 4–10 seconds ($0.04/$0.09 per second) and Fast at 480p for 4–5 seconds ($0.07 per second).
- Reuses the existing Seedance 2.0 handler while preserving the existing full model unchanged.
- Local Gen E2E verified authentication, resolution routing, keyframes through `media.pollinations.ai`, optional audio, MP4 tracks, billing, catalogs, exact cache replay, and burst behavior.
- Fast 720p and longer durations are intentionally excluded after repeated local latency exceeded 120 seconds.

Tests: focused Replicate/Seedance suites, registry and pricing invariants, snapshots, Biome, and Gen/Enter typechecks.

gist.headline: Two new seeds, faster films
gist.blurb: Seedance 2.0 grew two smaller branches: Mini for flexible 480p/720p clips and Fast for quick 480p renders. Polli checked the keyframes, audio, billing, and replay cache, because apparently a video seed needs paperwork.
gist.summary: Added paid-only Replicate video models `seedance-2.0-mini` and `seedance-2.0-fast`: Mini generates 4–10 second clips at 480p or 720p for $0.04/$0.09 per second, while Fast generates 4–5 second 480p clips for $0.07 per second.
gist.impact: Developers can now select Seedance 2.0 Mini for longer or 720p clips and Fast for short 480p videos, with authenticated generation, keyframes via `media.pollinations.ai`, optional audio, MP4 tracks, billing, and exact cache replay supported.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Seedance 2.0 as two friendly film-seed plants growing from separate labeled pots: a compact Mini plant projecting 480p and 720p film strips, and a speedy Fast plant projecting a short 480p strip. Polli, wearing a tiny director beret and holding a clapperboard, tends the plants beside a cozy retro video workstation; small flowers and vines connect the keyframe frames, audio notes, and MP4 reel.
